 USON Leak & Flow testing solutions 
 Uson Leak Testers 
Leak Testing Solutions
Uson provides automatic non-destructive air leak and flow measurement equipment and solutions used in product development and manufacturing environments for medical device, automotive, electric vehicle battery, packaging and industrial applications. Uson leak testers are highly configurable and are built with premium components ensuring maximum quality, reliability and performance.
We offer a comprehensive range of leak testing methods, including pressure decay, differential pressure decay, vacuum decay, mass flow, and sealed component leak testing. No matter the size or complexity of your application requirements, our dedicated team has the expertise to assist you throughout the entire process.
USON Leak testers
Astra Dash Leak Tester
Astra Dash is a leak and flow tester designed for easy implementation of the right test protocols. Its modular, pneumatically independent design, combined with the industry's most powerful and user-friendly interface, makes it the most flexible, scalable, reliable, and accessible tester of its generation.
 Read more
Sprint mD Multi-Channel Leak Tester
The Sprint mD tester is a cutting-edge automatic air leak and flow measurement device capable of performing a wide range of multi-functional testing, including pressure decay, vacuum, flow, occlusion, burst, crack, and sealed component for part integrity and performance testing.
 Read more
Qualitek mR Multi-Range Industrial Leak Tester
Qualitek mR is the unparalleled standard for lightning-fast and dependable leak testing in light to medium-duty industrial applications. With a perfect fusion of cutting-edge multi-range (mR) leak and flow testing technology and the unmatched expertise of Uson, Qualitek mR sets the benchmark for excellence.
 Read more
Optima vT High Versatility Leak Tester
Versatility is what distinguishes the Optima vT from other leak and flow testers. Its advanced features offer increased flexibility for numerous applications.
